title: Kessler Shield Holder Redemption Bonus — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Contract-holder bonus on Service Accounts and Repair Orders points redemptions.** The service contract bonus follows the redeeming vehicle's Kessler Shield contract, as the Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts records show, and the account's tier:
- where the redeeming vehicle carries an active Kessler Shield service contract and the account is at Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum, the bonus is 5%;
- where it carries an active Kessler Shield service contract and the account is at Kessler Owner Rewards Silver, the bonus is 3%;
- otherwise there is no service contract bonus.

The redeeming vehicle is the vehicle on the latest labor charge on the account. The bonus is a rate.

| Active contract on the redeeming vehicle | Gold or Platinum | Silver | Other tiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | 5% | 3% | none |
| No | none | none | none |
